power_keys.blocker: Read-only PM8998 PON/GPIO6 polling is implemented behind polariskeys=1, but no temporary Darwin 23 boot or qualified IOHID sink has passed.

display.blocker: PolarisDisplayContract validates only candidate panel names and 1080x2160/4-lane geometry; it does not provide a Darwin display provider or authorize DSI/backlight/GPU writes.

touch.hardware: Synaptics RMI4 touch controller over I2C (old chain: S3330; WOA/EDK2 path: S3708)
touch.blocker: The bridge is gated behind polaris-touch-hid and has not yet passed the macOS/Xcode ABI link, a temporary Darwin boot, or a real input-event trace on this Polaris.

battery.blocker: Revision-gated read-only fuel-gauge sampling is implemented behind polarisbattery=1, but charger state, userland publication and temporary Darwin 23 validation remain open.

gpu.blocker: The A630 resource policy is fail-closed and no Darwin GPU backend has passed temporary Polaris boot validation.

wifi.blocker: Bounded WLFW and H4 codec cores are present, but candidate DT resources still do not establish a Darwin WCN3998 transport, power sequence, firmware download or network data path.

bluetooth.blocker: Bounded H4 framing is present, but Android Bluetooth HAL libraries cannot replace a Darwin UART/HCI transport, firmware/NVM download and BlueTool bridge.

nfc.blocker: PolarisNfcContract records SE3/0x28/GPIO63 and remains read-only; no NCI transaction, IRQ ownership, firmware load or secure-element integration has been verified.

camera.blocker: PolarisCameraContract records CCI/CSIPHY/CSID and IMX363 ID facts but performs no sensor power, CCI read, CSI DMA, ISP or tuning load; temporary Darwin validation is still required.

fingerprint.blocker: Explicitly deferred by the porting plan.
